indian-institute-of-information-technolo.description: IIIT Allahabad is an Indian Institute of Information Technology on a 100-acre campus at Deoghat, Jhalwa, Prayagraj.
indian-institute-of-information-technolo.about: The institute was established in 1999 as a centre of excellence in information technology and allied areas. The Government of India gave it deemed university status in 2000. Its campus is at Deoghat, Jhalwa.

institute-of-engineering-and-rural-techn.description: The Institute of Engineering and Rural Technology is an autonomous institute at Chatham Lines, Prayagraj, which began in 1955 as Allahabad Polytechnic.
institute-of-engineering-and-rural-techn.about: IERT was established in 1955 as Allahabad Polytechnic. The Uttar Pradesh government granted it academic autonomy in 1982. Its degree programmes are approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University.
institute-of-engineering-and-rural-techn.address: 26, Chatham Lines, Prayagraj (Allahabad) - 211002, Uttar Pradesh, India
institute-of-engineering-and-rural-techn.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

ldc-institute-of-tecnical-studies.description: LDC Institute of Technical Studies is part of the LDC Group of Institutions in Prayagraj district.
ldc-institute-of-tecnical-studies.about: The institute belongs to the LDC Group of Institutions in Prayagraj. It offers technical programmes.

motilal-nehru-national-institute-of-tech.description: Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology is a National Institute of Technology at Teliarganj, Prayagraj, fully funded by the Government of India.
motilal-nehru-national-institute-of-tech.about: It was set up in 1961 as one of 17 Regional Engineering Colleges, jointly by the Government of India and the Government of Uttar Pradesh, and was associated with the University of Allahabad. On 26 June 2002 it became a National Institute of Technology and deemed university, fully funded by the Government of India.

prayag-institute-of-technology-and-manag.description: Prayag Institute of Technology and Management is a private engineering college in Prayagraj, listed by AKTU as an affiliated college.
prayag-institute-of-technology-and-manag.about: The college is listed on AKTU's Know Your College portal as an affiliated college. Its own website could not be confirmed.
prayag-institute-of-technology-and-manag.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

shambhunath-institute-of-engineering-and.description: Shambhunath Institute of Engineering and Technology is a private engineering college at Jhalwa near IIIT, Prayagraj, affiliated to AKTU.
shambhunath-institute-of-engineering-and.about: SIET was established in 2004 with 240 students and has grown into the Shambhunath group of seven institutes. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University. Its campus covers about 25 acres.
shambhunath-institute-of-engineering-and.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

united-college-of-engineering-and-resear.description: United College of Engineering and Research is a private engineering college of the United Group of Institutions at Naini, Prayagraj, affiliated to AKTU.
united-college-of-engineering-and-resear.about: UCER was established in 1998. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow and approved by AICTE. It offers B.Tech and postgraduate programmes in several engineering branches.
united-college-of-engineering-and-resear.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

united-institute-of-technology.description: United Institute of Technology is a private engineering college of the United Group of Institutions at Naini, Prayagraj, affiliated to AKTU.
united-institute-of-technology.about: UIT was established in 2007 as a constituent institute of the United Group of Institutions. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow and approved by AICTE. Its campus is at Naini, Prayagraj.
united-institute-of-technology.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

feroze-gandhi-institute-of-engg-and-tech.description: Feroze Gandhi Institute of Engineering and Technology is an engineering college in Rae Bareli district, affiliated to AKTU.
feroze-gandhi-institute-of-engg-and-tech.about: The institute was established in October 2004. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow. It has a 22.5-acre campus and offers bachelor's and master's programmes, including aeronautical and mechanical engineering.
feroze-gandhi-institute-of-engg-and-tech.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

prabhat-engineering-college.description: Prabhat Engineering College is a private engineering college on the Kanpur-Kalpi road (NH-2) near Bara toll, affiliated to AKTU.
prabhat-engineering-college.about: The college was established in 2008 by the Prabhat Educational Trust. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and approved by AICTE. It offers B.Tech, MBA and diploma programmes.
prabhat-engineering-college.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow
